Specific Procurement Notice

Request for Bids

Goods

(One-Envelope Bidding Process)

Country: Seychelles

Name of Project: Solid Waste Management Project

Contract Title: Procurement of Materials for the Expansion of the Providence Landfill

Project No. P181243

RFB Reference No.: SC-PDCS-575616-GO-RFB

  1. The Ministry of Environment, Climate, Energy & Natural Resources financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Solid Waste Management Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract[1] for Procurement of Materials for the Expansion of the Providence Landfill.

2.      The Ministry of Environment, Climate, Energy & Natural Resources now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for Procurement of Materials for the Expansion of the Providence Landfill.

3.      Bidding will be conducted through international competitive procurement using a Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers Fifth Edition September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”) and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations.

4.      Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from Ministry, Environment, Climate, Energy & Natural Resources, Program Development Coordination Section, , First Floor, House of Francis, Perseverance, Procurement Consultant, Sandra Ibrahim  through email sandra.ibrahim@env.gov.sc copied to WBprojectcoordinator@env.gov.sc and cpc@env.gov.sc

6.      Bids must be delivered to the address below on or before 11.00 am (Seychelles Time) by or before the 20th November 2026. Electronic Bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. Bids will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below Ministry, Environment, Climate, Energy & Natural Resources, Program Development Coordination Section, First Floor, House of Francis, Perseverance at 11.00am (Seychelles Time) on the 20th November 2026.

7.      All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid-Securing Declaration Form.

8.      Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document.

9.      The address(es) referred to above is:

 

 

Sandra Ibrahim

Procurement Consultant

Program Development Coordination Section

Ministry of Environment, Climate, Energy & Natural Resources

First Floor

House of Francis

Perseverance

Victoria, Mahe, Seychelles
